criteria.support_condition: Dated policies establish the asserted sequence, and comparative disclosures or reproducible usage evidence show that the overlapping changes made available subscription access harder to determine.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated records refute the asserted sequence, or comparable evidence shows that the changes did not reduce ascertainability. A chronology error alone does not settle the whole causal assertion.
